user

Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The Camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old Henry Jenkins, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal, the official record for the Oldest Human to Ever Live.

**OFFICIAL** (Voiceover)
And the record holder is... Henry Jenkins! Born On February 12, 1895, Henry has defied the odds and lived an astonishing 127 years.

The room erupts in applause as Henry smiles, his eyes shining with pride. He is escorted to the stage, where he is congratulated by the officials and presented with a bouquet of flowers.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. HENRY'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Henry lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He is surrounded by old photographs and mementos from his long life. He takes a deep breath, and his mind begins to wander.

**HENRY** (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young... Quantum Immortality. It Said That In A Multiverse, Every Time A Person Dies, Their Consciousness Creates A New Reality, Where They Survive.

As Henry's mind delves deeper into the theory, his expression changes. His eyes take on a far-off look, and his breathing becomes labored.

**HENRY** (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just... Reincarnated? In A Different Reality?

Henry's voice rises, and his body begins to shake. He throws off the covers and gets out of bed, pacing back and forth across the room.

**HENRY** (V.O)
I've Been Living In A Dream World, A Simulation Created By Some Higher Power. And I've Been Trying To Wake Up For 127 Years!

Henry's eyes roll back in his head, and he collapses to the floor, his body wracked with sobs. He screams at the top of his lungs, "I'M NOT DEAD! I'M NOT DEAD!"

**CUT TO:**

**EXT. HENRY'S HOUSE - NIGHT**

The camera pans across the quiet neighborhood, the only sound the distant hum of crickets. The lights in Henry's house flicker, and the curtains billow in the wind. It's as if the very fabric of reality is unraveling.

**FADE TO BLACK.**

**THE END.**
